response.sql: WITH tel AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS v FROM signals), k1 AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_pulse FROM tel t, b1 WHERE t.avg_pulse > b1.v), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS v FROM k1), fin AS (SELECT k1.avg_pulse FROM k1, b2 WHERE k1.avg_pulse > b2.v) SELECT AVG(fin.avg_pulse) AS mean_avg_pulse, AVG(fin.avg_pulse - b1.v) AS mean_excess_over_first_baseline, AVG(fin.avg_pulse - b2.v) AS mean_excess_over_second_baseline FROM fin, b1, b2

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes whose pulsepersec values are all NULL have a NULL average and are excluded by the comparisons; the first baseline is the plain average over all non-null signal rows.
Comparisons are strict (above), and the second baseline is computed only from the telescopes kept after the first filter.
